nodes.title: The POT_T fix campaign - seven stages run as one pass instead of one defect every thirty minutes
nodes.description: Gavin: 'can you please fix all of these issues rather than encountering them every 30 minutes... put together a workgraph for it and just get it done properly and batch the next videos after the fixes are done.' Seven staged fixes: the stale account skill snapshot (root cause), the POT_T migration, the drift dedupe, the last INV2 violation, repo hygiene, this workgraph amend, then the AI News batch.

verification.evidence: griot-live-artifacts commits b7643ee (POT_T migration) and 0959246 (drift merge + 4 entries); DGS plan card v41; Suite Drift Codex card v26; cinopsis verify_invariants.py RESULT: PASS on all three.
verification.result: done - stages S0 through S5 landed; S6 (the batch) runs on the cdp door which is clean.

nodes.title: The account skill snapshot Cowork loads was 220 lines behind the device - the structural cause of the POT_T error
nodes.description: The dgs-plan-update copy this cloud surface loads was the 2026-08-03 revision: 321 lines, md5 26823bc, with ZERO occurrences of POT_T, sunset or OSSMETA. The canonical device file is 541 lines, md5 fb2dcfe, committed at 1185033. The surface was therefore instructed to write OSS to the standalone shelf - exactly what the sunset rule forbids - and to call update_artifact, which is unmounted in cloud. The error was not carelessness; the doctrine never reached the surface that needed it. Standalone account skills have no device-side push route: griot-plugin-update and prism-sideload are for PLUGINS and running either on a standalone skill is itself documented drift. The socket is the skill review card.

verification.evidence: md5sum + wc -l + grep -c on both copies: account /root/.claude/skills/synced/.../dgs-plan-update/SKILL.md = 321 lines, POT_T x0, sunset x0, OSSMETA x0; device C:\Users\digit\.claude\skills\dgs-plan-update\SKILL.md = 541 lines, POT_T x1, sunset x3, OSSMETA x2, git log 1185033.
verification.result: defect-fixed - canonical 541-line SKILL.md proposed via the review card and saved by Gavin 2026-09-18; the account skill's description now carries 'OSS routes to POT_T in the plan only; the standalone shelf artifact is SUNSET.'

nodes.title: The shelf-to-POT_T leak was 171 tools across 41 source videos, not 115 from one bad pass
nodes.description: POT_T is the ONE source for OSS since the 2026-09-03 sunset, but 171 tools on the sunset shelf had no POT_T row, spread across 41 different source videos - a long-standing leak, not one pass. The raw counts actively hid it: POT_T 1157 vs shelf 1263 reads as a gap of 106, because POT_T also holds 65 rows the shelf never had. A length delta is not a leak count; membership must be tested by slug AND normalized name in both directions.

verification.evidence: node extractor evaluating POT_T and the shelf T array from live/dgs-definitive-plan.html and live/griot-potluck-oss-repo.html; 171 missing by slug-or-normalized-name, src histogram spanning 41 distinct potluck:<videoId> values.
verification.result: defect-fixed - all 171 migrated additively, POT_T 1157 -> 1328, plus 115 OSSMETA and 54 OSSMETA_N provenance entries; post-write check reports zero shelf tools still missing. Commit b7643ee, card v41.

nodes.title: The oss-inspo mirror already carried all 171 - so the fix was additive and stripped nothing
nodes.description: Doctrine says regenerate oss-inspo from POT_T. Done naively here that would have deleted any oss-inspo item lacking a POT_T row - Gavin's content. Checking first showed the opposite of the expected shape: the 171 tools DID have hand-written oss-inspo items and were missing only from POT_T, which is precisely why nothing looked broken on the Potluck tab. Orphan count after migration: zero. So the mirror was left completely untouched rather than regenerated.

verification.evidence: ITEMS parsed from the plan: 1341 oss-inspo items; every one resolves to a POT_T row or to one of the 171 migrated rows - orphans = 0. Post-write: ITEMS 1857 -> 1857 and oss-inspo 1341 -> 1341, byte-identical.
verification.result: corrected-verified - the safe order is prove-orphans-zero BEFORE regenerating, and prefer additive when the mirror is already ahead of the source.

nodes.title: 331 oss-inspo items carry a placeholder instead of a real slug
nodes.description: 331 of 1341 oss-inspo items have no resolvable repo slug - they carry literal placeholders such as '- unverified (named in video)' or '- hosted (cloudflare workers ai)'. This is the bare-spoken-name class that video-oss-gate.py exists to fail loudly on. They all collapse into one key, so any slug-keyed analysis silently treats hundreds of distinct tools as one: a first dedupe pass reported 258 duplicates that were almost entirely this bucket. Real duplicate slugs number 59, and POT_T separately carries 52 real dup-slug keys over 250 extra rows.

verification.evidence: regex classification over the 1341 oss-inspo items: 331 placeholder-or-empty slugs; 59 real slugs appearing more than once; POT_T dup-slug analysis before/after the migration showed 52 -> 53 real dup keys, the one addition being mrdoob/three.js legitimately shared by three.js and TSL.
verification.result: flagged-not-fixed - resolve each placeholder from the video DESCRIPTION (captions garble repo names; descriptions do not) and confirm with gh api repos/<slug>. Until then never key dedupe or parity on slug alone.

nodes.title: Both bridge directions cache - the dgs-plan-update exemption for the commit direction is wrong
nodes.description: dgs-plan-update Rule 2 step 4 says the stage cache is keyed by path but that cloud-to-device commit_files 'writes bytes directly and is not affected'. Both halves of that were disproven in one session. Commit direction: a rewrite to the same device path delivered the previous version - 1950 bytes in the container, 1905 on disk, reported written with no rejection, and the stale code then ran twice. Stage direction: a comparison silently read a copy staged earlier in the same session and reported the live plan card as in sync when it was a full commit behind, which nearly authorised a publish on a false premise.

verification.evidence: byte-length mismatch 1950 vs 1905 on the commit direction; and this pass, /mnt/user-data/uploads/.../dgs-definitive-plan.html dated 09:18 returned POT_T 1157 / ITEMS 1834 while the live artifact fetch returned the same - resolving against git HEAD instead showed the working file at ITEMS 1857.
verification.result: flagged-not-fixed - drift entry merged and updated, but the SKILL.md sentence granting the commit direction an exemption still stands and should be corrected at source.

nodes.title: CRLF phantom churn traced to system-level core.autocrlf with no .gitattributes
nodes.description: The recurring ~10-file phantom diff under live/ is not a mount quirk. git config reports core.autocrlf=true at the SYSTEM level, inherited by the repo, and griot-live-artifacts has no .gitattributes. So every checkout writes CRLF into the working tree and any tool that rewrites a file with LF manufactures a whole-file diff. Twelve files were confirmed CRLF-only this pass by comparing carriage-return-stripped hashes against git HEAD - zero real content at risk.

verification.evidence: git config --system core.autocrlf = true; repo core.autocrlf = true; .gitattributes absent. Per-file check: tr -d '\r' hash of the working copy equals the same hash of git HEAD for all twelve dirty files. git checkout restored them; tree now clean.
verification.result: flagged-not-fixed - working tree cleaned, but the generator is still armed and will re-dirty on the next Windows-side write. Repo policy is Gavin's call - see S8.

nodes.title: INV2 had one violation, not forty-five - and the one was a music mix, not a missing transcript
nodes.description: An in-session claim that 45 INV2 violations remained across three sessions was wrong: the count had been taken before the description-source backfill landed. The real figure was one, and the offending record was not an AI video at all - 'Gentle & Smooth R&B Mix in a Brooklyn Loft, Set 52, Ceema' had ridden into the AI News catch-up session with captions disabled, so it carried a digest with no backing transcript and no declared source. Also corrected in the same pass: the claim that the next batch had to wait about four hours. Only the timedtext door was blocked; the cdp door was clean at fail_streak 0, so the batch was never actually gated.

verification.evidence: scripts/verify_invariants.py before: INV2 FAIL, 1 violation, cMvi1GS9R3E. yt-dlp metadata fetch (no caption request, so the blocked timedtext door was never touched) recovered a 2645-character description; a description-backed digest was written with digest_source='description' and an explicit 'OSS harvest: none - the description was read in full rather than skipped'. After: INV1 PASS, INV2 PASS, INV3 PASS.
verification.result: defect-fixed - first fully clean invariant gate; the video is retained and documented rather than dropped, per the rule that every video in the playlist is there for a reason.

nodes.title: Add a .gitattributes to griot-live-artifacts to kill the CRLF churn at its source
nodes.description: One line - '* text=auto eol=lf' - would end the recurring phantom diff permanently instead of cleaning it up each time. It is a repo-wide policy change affecting every file and every future checkout, so it is not something to apply unilaterally. Deliberately left as a proposal.

verification.evidence: Root cause established in N64: system-level core.autocrlf=true, no .gitattributes present in the repo.
verification.result: open - awaiting Gavin's yes or no.

nodes.title: Resolve the 331 placeholder slugs from video descriptions, not captions
nodes.description: Proposed pass: for each placeholder-slug oss-inspo item, pull its source video's description, extract the real owner/repo, confirm with gh api repos/<slug>, and write it back to POT_T plus its OSSMETA entry. Descriptions are the authoritative source here - captions garbled Colibri into Calibri and Hermes into Airmes on a previous run, while descriptions yielded 69 of 69 verified slugs.

verification.evidence: N62 classification: 331 of 1341 oss-inspo items carry a placeholder; 214 description files already exist on disk under cinopsis data/description_*.txt.
verification.result: open - awaiting Gavin's yes or no; sized but not started.
